note: Narrative rival defeats (M12, spec section 3): a rival fight the player is meant to lose without the run ending. Rare, foreshadowed, once per rival.

defs.foreshadow: It says it has been training somewhere you have not been.
defs.introLine: This time the rival does not hold back.
defs.defeatLine: Your last Pokémon can no longer stand. This is not how it ends, but it hurts.
defs.victoryLine: I told you I would be ahead of you. Keep up, if you can.
defs.afterLine: They say you were beaten by your own rival.

defs.foreshadow: It smiles like it has already seen how this ends.
defs.introLine: The rival's whole team is back, and every one of them looks ready.
defs.defeatLine: One by one your Pokémon fall. You gave everything and it was still not enough.
defs.victoryLine: Not yet. Come find me when you are really ready.
defs.afterLine: Word is the rival crushed you again.

defs.foreshadow: It says the next time you meet will decide everything.
defs.introLine: This is the fight the rival has been waiting for.
defs.defeatLine: Your last Pokémon goes down. The silence afterwards is the worst part.
defs.victoryLine: I did it. I finally did it. Now get up and prove I was right to wait for you.
defs.afterLine: They say the rival finally settled it with you.
